_note: Language word lists for normalize.py (a data file: no language lists in code). roman_urdu: words that only occur in untranslated Roman Urdu; English values never hold them. english: function words plus a few common ones, enough to tell Roman Urdu with some English mixed in from pure Roman Urdu; deliberately excludes proper nouns students use inside Urdu sentences (board, college names). rupee_words: how a currency field says rupees, normalized to PKR.
